title: I made a game where you ride a freight elevator into hell and every floor, demons get on
author: HELLEVATOROP
selftext:
Free demo, runs in your browser: [hellevator.online](http://hellevator.online)

Solo dev. Four heroes, eight bosses, fighting-game inputs (quarter circles, half circles, buffered specials), and the blood stays on the walls.

Most useful feedback: how the combat feels in the first two minutes. Tell me what's off.

replies.author: HELLEVATOROP
replies.body: thank you king, that's honestly prioritized over everything besides gamefeel for this project so feels good to hear people are vibing with it. did you try the demo?

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
This is pretty wild, in a good way. I like the vibe. 

...It feels very... spammy? The game gives great feedback and weight in terms of combat holistically, but I never felt any sense of skill expression. I just mashed attack and enemies exploded. 

The lack of skill expression then bled over into a sense of lacking any real depth or challenge. Hits landed on me didn't really feel earned, but at the same time they also didn't seem to matter. 

  
Not necessarily a problem, though. It reminds me a lot of the gameplay in Diablo III - which is not my cup of tea, but I know it is the cup of tea for quite a few people.

replies.author: HELLEVATOROP
replies.body: you're meant to be able to have fun, feel overpowered, and button mash vs. demon waves, but actually think a little and dodge attacks vs the lower floor bosses. Did you beat the demo yet?

replies.author: HELLEVATOROP
replies.body: I'm also curious which character you played

replies.author: AsparagusOk8818
replies.body: Yes; beat the demo with the Samurai. I just mashed J.

replies.author: HELLEVATOROP
replies.body: J is a good button. Def gonna tune the bosses to be more dangerous, probably the tall grunt demons and flying demons as well thank you for playing it sincerely.

replies.author: HELLEVATOROP
replies.body: i update the tuning based off your feedback. I adjusted the hitboxes so J doesn't hit behind your character anymore (that was def overpowered) and i increased the health of some of the enemies, bosses, and made them telegraph their movies a bit more in exchange for them doing more damage. I think it definitely feels different now. still powered but less spammy. Thank you for your post, every bit of feedback helps.

replies.author: HELLEVATOROP
replies.body: Full patch notes from your feedback, thanks again king [https://www.hellevator.online/patches/v0-8-0/](https://www.hellevator.online/patches/v0-8-0/)

comments.author: CertainBlue
comments.body: actually tried it, the game overall feels decently good though it's pretty spammy, I played with the samurai and I didn't even realize that you had more than one attack button cause I just mashed through every level. The animations, the juice, the SFX and the music felt in the right place. The augments/options to pick in between rounds didn't feel very impactful. The bosses felt too easy to kill, I only lost to satan.

replies.author: HELLEVATOROP
replies.body: yeah Satan is much harder than the other bosses right now, need to tune them for sure. Its meant to be spammy/button mashy aside from the boss fights. I'd be interested to hear your take on some of the other characters if you have another 10min or so. I also only die to satan normally.
